# Projektai777

> Websites, CRM systems, process automation, AI tools and visibility in AI search for business. Fixed price, the code stays yours. I reply within a working day.

Ignas — Self-employed (individual activity) · Lithuania.

## Services

- Websites: A new site, an improvement of the one you have, or new features added to it.
- CRM systems: I build a CRM around how you work: clients, orders and reminders in one place.
- Process automation: I connect the tools you already use so the repetitive work happens without your hands.
- AI tools: Artificial intelligence that works for you: answers customers, sorts inquiries, reads documents.
- Visibility in AI search: So that ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI answers name your business: the first check is free, then I send a short report each month.
- Ads on Google, Facebook and Instagram: A monthly service with no long contract: stop any time, the ad money goes straight to Google and Meta, and each month you get a short report on how many enquiries came and what one cost. If I run your ads, the AI search check is free.

## Questions

- [How much does a website, CRM or automation cost?](https://projektai777.eu/en/#faq-1): The price depends on the scope, so I name it once you write what you need: within a working day you get a clear description of the work and a fixed, one-off price. You pay a 50 % advance and the rest after handover.
- [How long does the work take?](https://projektai777.eu/en/#faq-2): The deadline goes into the contract together with the price, counted in working days from the advance and the materials you provide. Along the way I show an intermediate result and, within the agreed work, change it until it fits.
- [Can you improve the website I already have?](https://projektai777.eu/en/#faq-3): Yes. I improve working sites and add new features to them, for example a booking window, a photo gallery or a registration form. That is what I did for Fortuna Hostel and Neramioji klasė.
- [Will I get the source code?](https://projektai777.eu/en/#faq-4): Yes. Once the work is paid in full, you get the full source code and the right to change it, host it anywhere and pass it on.
- [Are there monthly fees?](https://projektai777.eu/en/#faq-5): For a website you pay me no monthly fee: the price is one-off, and wherever possible I choose free infrastructure. A domain, hosting or other paid outside service, if one is needed, you pay straight to its provider, and the account is in your name. Only the ads service and the monthly AI search reports are paid each month.
- [What is visibility in AI search?](https://projektai777.eu/en/#faq-6): It is work to make ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI answers name your business when people ask about what you offer. The first check is free; after that I send a short report each month.
- [How do I start?](https://projektai777.eu/en/#faq-7): Write a few sentences in the contact form (https://projektai777.eu/en/#contact), by e-mail, Telegram or Messenger. I reply within a working day with a clear scope and price, not with an offer to schedule a call.

## Work

- Fortuna Hostel (finished): A Vilnius hostel's three-language WordPress website gained a booking window inside the site, a photo gallery the staff manage themselves, Google review collection and a safe technical upgrade. https://projektai777.eu/en/work/fortuna-hostel/
- Neramioji klasė (finished): A national creative platform for pupils got a new entry page, an English version and one registration form through which pupils upload their work straight into the organisation's own storage, with no account needed. https://projektai777.eu/en/work/neramioji-klase/
- Tinystudy (in progress): My own product in progress for adult students whose school or university uses Moodle: course materials become short study topics, and the plan picks what to learn and what to review each day before the next test. https://projektai777.eu/en/work/tinystudy/
